name: fix-watcher-library-scope
body: Amendment. Source statement: requirements.requirement.templates-live-reload and requirements.requirement.live-reload said changes 'anywhere under the RESOLVED library root' are detected, and solution.component.file-watcher / domain.service.watch-deck said the watcher follows the resolved root 'recursively'/'everything under' it (naming library.yaml, slides/, sections/, themes/, media/). Problem [with user]: now that the library loader ignores every non-library top-level entry, a library is commonly a git repository, and the watcher walked and watched the entire resolved root — including `.git/` — so a git operation in a git-hosted library triggered a spurious deck reload. Resolution [with user]: the watcher follows only the library structure — the library root's `library.yaml` and the `slides/`, `sections/`, `themes/` and `media/` subtrees (recursively); every other top-level entry under the resolved root is ignored, so it never triggers a reload. Amended requirements.requirement.templates-live-reload, requirements.requirement.live-reload, solution.component.file-watcher, domain.service.watch-deck and domain.entity.deck-changed; internal/watch/watch.go now registers the library root non-recursively plus only those four subtrees, and filters every event through a library-structure test. Deck-level watching (slides/, assets/, kalide.yaml) is unchanged.
